Everyone should stop pretending Donald Trump singularly turned the presidency into a monarchy. 

Leaders of *both* parties colluded to ignore warnings and give him the power he’s now abusing. 

It’s annoying that this truth has been memory-holed.

This isn’t “both sides”-ing the issue. One side has been worse. But it’s also a recognition that what’s going on is a culmination of a multi-decade plan that figures in both parties colluded to create — as they were cheered on by their partisan fans. 

Ignoring that ignores history — which will keep repeating itself unless people start being honest about what’s going on.
